boundary: R1899 completes X/x for the integer palette. The first row is unchanged; each later output row is the current input XOR the previous output for prefix, or XOR the previous ORIGINAL input for difference. The interface uses exact .data output symbols on arbitrary initially clean configurations, and the actual raw native machine loads, computes, emits, halts and clears scratch. The binary decoder is explicit: this is not an F3 arithmetic result. Geometry holds for every time, including the halted tail, and arbitrary public prefix/difference choices. Correctness and geometry requireW>0; linear raw time requiresW<=P; normalized geometry requiresP>0 andW/P->0 asymptotically. Original unchanged; no commits/pushes; no unrestricted transpose decision or novelty claim.

dependency_simplification:
REUSE AND DRIFT CHECK
Read the source fast/slow X/x implementations in controls/nonlinear_bank_search.py. Searched the pinned mathlib/core Boolean XOR and natural-bitwise libraries and mathlib Computability for prefix/rotation/TM helpers. Core Bool simplification and mathlib Nat arithmetic/limits are reused. Mathlib has general bitwise algebra, not this project's native tape schedule and paid-resource interface. The relevant full executor was already local: MaskedStrideBankStage.result_spec, schedule_exact, ticks_le, MaskedStrideScan.value_recurrence/value_congr_upto, MaskedStrideWordMotion and StrideStageApproximation. NativeIOModeProduct transports it with no extra paid step. RawProgramShell supplies actual native IO, halt and resources; RawShellNativeMotion and RawShellResources supply the physical-time and state-bit endpoints. These new files are integrations of those results, not new algorithms or bounds.
Inspected next-use libraries: RawRowArithmeticData.evaluate_eq already permits arbitrary initial carry, while RawRowArithmeticRun resets it to sub. Generalize/reuse that layer for whole-bank I/i with blank operand: sub=false,carry=true adds1; sub=true,carry=false subtracts1 modulo2^P. BinaryCarry.result_identity and existing modular-value proofs should settle semantics. For motion, the existing coarse row errorO(W) is insufficient whenW=P: use the fixed four-step cell scan and a constant number of seek/cleanup ramps to obtainO(1) error. Do not reuse an errorO(P) as if it vanished. Existing BankRotation is binary; a later symbol-preserving rotation can reuse generic block reversal and row composition, but row-dependent offsets need explicit indexed scheduling.
novelty: No novelty claim; integration of existing native masked-stride executor into the exact integer palette.
